text:
Animating At Pixar: Advice, Memes, & Evil Bullseye🐴 I The Pixar Show
This week on The Pixar Show we have animators Kristen Willsher and Theresa Reyes! They've animated on Toy Story 5, Inside Out, Soul and more! Join us as we chat about what it's like doing the job of an animator, some of their favorite and hardest moments they've had to bring to life, and what it's like seeing their animation take on new life as a meme. Catch more behind the scenes with The Pixar Show on Pixar's main YouTube Channel!
